correct_completion: I would learn to play the piano.
full_sentence: If I had more time, I would learn to play the piano.

options.text: I will learn to play the piano.
options.why_wrong: 'Will' belongs to the first conditional. The second conditional needs 'if' with the past simple and 'would' in the main clause.

options.text: I learned to play the piano yesterday.
options.why_wrong: The past simple describes a finished action, not an imagined result of the condition in the stem.

options.text: I would learn to play the piano.
I have learned to play the piano.
options.why_wrong: The present perfect describes a completed experience, not the imagined result of a situation that is not real.

grammar_focus: Second conditional: if + past simple, would + base verb
explanation: The second conditional describes an imagined present or future situation, so the main clause uses 'would' plus the base verb. Ukrainian speakers may leave out 'would' because Ukrainian marks the conditional with a particle that does not change the verb, so the English 'would' has to be added explicitly.
translation: Якби в мене був більше часу, я б навчився грати на піаніно.
